name: ANSI/IEEE Single-phase AC source form
summary: IEEE-library form of single-phase ac source: a single-phase AC source identifies a documented source boundary in a schematic or SLD.
description: This reference locates single-phase ac source in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous family. A single-phase AC source identifies a documented source boundary in a schematic or SLD. The source label and supply data explain what provides the circuit's voltage and frequency. The public library uses HPW1_1PH for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.

Determine whether the source is a utility connection, transformer winding or auxiliary source. A source-boundary symbol is not a product-specific generator or transformer diagram. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
